subject: CloudNine launch — media briefing, quote text and embargo timing
messages:
From: Claire D'Souza <claire@cloudnine.io>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudNine launch — request for quote + embargo

Hi Lauren,

Hope you're well — CloudNine is planning a product launch the week of May 25 and we'd love to include Redwood in the press materials. Can you provide: a short customer quote (1–2 sentences), a slightly longer quote (2–3 sentences) for the press kit, and confirmation on whether Redwood is comfortable with an embargo until Mon, May 25 17:00 PT?

I'm also attaching our press brief (PDF) so you can see the narrative and target outlets. If possible, could you send a draft quote by EOD Friday (May 22)?

Contact for logistics: Tom Kline (tkline@cloudnine.io). PR lead: Stark PR (press@starkpr.com).

Thanks — excited to see this happen.

— Claire
Claire D'Souza
Head of Communications, CloudNine
Attachment: CloudNine_PressBrief_v1.pdf

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: CloudNine launch — request for quote + embargo

Team — forwarding Claire's request. Quick asks:
- Short quote + long quote variants by EOD Friday (May 22).
- Confirm logo usage and any legal sign-off required.
- Are we ok with the proposed embargo (May 25, 17:00 PT)?

I'm happy to be the primary contact. Marissa, can you draft the quotes? Jonas, can you check legal/logo? Stephanie, please prep the one-pager with suggested stats and token-cost note for media (if asked).

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 11:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudNine launch — request for quote + embargo

Lauren / all — draft options below. Kept the tone tight for press. Happy to iterate.

SHORT (1 sentence):
"CloudNine's platform materially accelerates our customers' time-to-insight; we've seen consistent 3–4x throughput improvements on real workloads when paired with Redwood's serving platform."

LONG (2–3 sentences):
"CloudNine has been an outstanding partner — their approach to data-driven product development, combined with Redwood's inference runtime, has enabled customers to reduce inference latency and cost at scale. Together we've been able to shorten model iteration cycles and ship higher-quality AI features faster."

Notes: kept vendor-neutral but positive. If CloudNine wants a stronger value claim we can sharpen numbers; otherwise these should map to their brief fine.

Attachment: RNWD_Quote_Short_v2.docx (two quote variants, tracked changes).

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Kline <tkline@cloudnine.io>
To: Claire D'Souza <claire@cloudnine.io>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudNine launch — request for quote + embargo

Hi Claire / Lauren — quick clarification from CloudNine side: the embargo window will be until Mon May 25, 17:00 PT. We prefer a short, punchy quote for the headline and a slightly longer one for the press kit. Also want to ensure we have logo usage permission — can Redwood sign the attached logo authorization form?

Also: our comms team prefers the short quote to lead with a concrete customer outcome if possible (i.e., latency or throughput improvement). If you can't include numbers, 'materially accelerates time-to-insight' is OK.

— Tom
Tom Kline
VP Product, CloudNine
Attachment: Logo_Usage_Authorization.pdf

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Claire D'Souza <claire@cloudnine.io>, Tom Kline <tkline@cloudnine.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, press@starkpr.com
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood quote + logo sign-off (CloudNine launch)

Claire / Tom — thanks for the guidance. Please find our proposed final quote options below and attached signed logo authorization. We're comfortable with the embargo until Mon May 25 17:00 PT.

PROPOSED SHORT (headline):
"Using Redwood's inference platform, CloudNine customers are seeing up to 3x faster model responses, enabling near-real-time product experiences."

PROPOSED LONG (press kit):
"CloudNine's product vision and Redwood's high-throughput serving runtime make AI features performant and cost-effective at scale. By combining our runtime optimizations with CloudNine's data pipelines, customers benefit from significantly lower latency and faster iteration cycles for model-driven features."

Attachments: RNWD_Quote_Short_v2.docx, Logo_Usage_Authorization.pdf

If these look good, Claire — please confirm the final wording (feel free to edit) and confirm you'll include the RNWD company blurb we shared in the press kit. Also send over the DocuSign link for the logo use agreement and a final distribution list for the embargoed send.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Claire D'Souza <claire@cloudnine.io>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, Tom Kline <tkline@cloudnine.io>
Cc: press@starkpr.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood quote + logo sign-off (CloudNine launch)

Lauren / Tom / Marissa — these read well, thanks. A couple tiny edits to the short headline: please remove the specific 'up to' phrasing and we'll use:

FINAL SHORT (approved):
"Redwood's inference platform helps CloudNine deliver 3x faster model responses, enabling near-real-time product experiences."

LONG approved as-is.

I've uploaded the final press kit to the Drive folder and sent the DocuSign for logo use — link below. Distribution list includes TechCrunch, VentureBeat, The Information, and our enterprise partners list. Embargo remains May 25, 17:00 PT.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_cloudnine-presskit
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abc-press-logo-agreement

Looking forward to the launch.

— Claire
Claire D'Souza
Head of Communications, CloudNine
Attachment: CloudNine_PressBrief_v1.pdf (updated in Drive)
